content:
Eventually Secel leads Jean-paul to the sight of their future home. “And everyone has said they can help where they can.” She finishes before turning to her husband. “Now.. about that talk.” 

She forced herself to look at him as she spoke. “I’ve changed, Jean-paul. I… channeled both Athena and Zariel at once. Then Zariel took over, and…” She began tearing up. “She took over.” She turns around, unable to look at him. “I failed. I became the very thing my parents worked so hard to prevent.” She finally breaks down into sobs.

After holding his new wife, comforting her for several hours telling her how much he loves her and how it isn't truly her fault, and about how he doesn't view her any differently. He says, "I too have changed. Since I left I traveled up and down the coast, rallying allies and fighting the English. I've had more brushes with death than I care to count. I couldn't face you with my shame, not just my true ancestry but also my remaining loyalty to the crown"

"But... but I..." She sniffs as she forces herself to look into his eyes. "Maybe we were destined even more than I thought." She then stands on her tip toes to give him a small kiss. "Regardless of what you've done, I will never not love you."

"And I will never stop loving you. No matter what happens next that will always be true. I'd like to start a home here, help our new nation prosper, and help Empire city recover. We still have a lot of work cut out for us, but there is no one I'd rather take those steps with"

(if you two would rather have a proper ceremony be in epilogue rather than rped, and you'd like me to do it, yeet me some generic lines to replace with what Sabrine would say and I can get that sorted without being spoiled)

"And I can't see myself taking those steps married to anyone else." She then snaps her fingers. "Oh! I also found that in what used to be the basement." She points to the Demon Armor, just standing where she put it.
Secel, after a long day’s work with Jean-paul, pulls him along to <#861700807626588220>

Secel eventually returns, smiling at the progress on the Nathaniel home. There was still something missing she thought as she held tightly to her husband. 

“This is where our story begins?” She asks him. Smiling at his nod, she leans up and kisses him. “Let’s get started then.”
*A Barn owl lands on the burnt remains of a stump, with small tufts of grass beginning to spring up around it. There it sits, watching, vigilant, proud.*
She looks over at the owl. “Athena.”
*The Owl Hoots once, making eye contact with them both, before it flies off into the night.*
She smiles and waves, then looks back at the home. “Together forever.”
